caption: Our prompt as entered: a two-slide presentation, slide 1 titled 'TEST Zoë Alpha (AIBM-001)' and slide 2 with one exact line and nothing else. The sidebar shows the starting balance of 500 credits; the account name is hidden.
While generating, the title slide already reads 'Zoë Alpha AIBM-001', without 'TEST' and without the brackets from our prompt.
Slide two: our line set in capitals, with a label 'VALIDATION STATUS // AIBM-001' and a large '001' that we did not ask for.

Finished overview: an invented 'PROTOCOL ALPHA, Internal hardware validation' headline over a mountain landscape with hardware renders, a 'Made with Prezi' badge, and the credit balance down from 500 to 350; the account avatar is hidden.
Share tab of a new presentation: set to Openbaar (public), with AI analysis, reuse by viewers and viewer downloads all switched on by default; the link and QR code are hidden.
Owner's Download tab: PDF, editable PPTX and SCORM are all marked Plus; the account avatar is hidden.
Upgrade dialog: 350 AI credits left and Plus offered at €15 a month, billed annually.

Plus trial screen: €0.00 due now and the subscription starting on 20 November, but a payment method is still required; billing details list €180.00 a year plus 21% VAT of €37.80. The saved payment method is hidden.
